_prototype_verification: PROTOTYPE rule pack. Numbers reflect publicly documented North Carolina Job Opportunity Tax Credit parameters for Tier 2 counties; verify all values (per-job amount, tier designations, thresholds, benefit period) against current NC Department of Commerce and NC DOR guidance before any real client use.

credit.name: North Carolina Job Expansion Tax Credit
credit.summary: Statutory credit per net new full-time job created in Tier 2 NC counties; the per-job amount scales with county tier designation (Tier 1 distressed counties receive higher amounts).

benefit._note: Tier 2 county per-job amount. Tier 1 (most distressed) counties may qualify for up to $1,500/job. This stub uses Charlotte/Raleigh-MSA metro rates.

geographic_scope._note: County tier designations are updated annually by NC Dept. of Commerce. Prototype treats all NC counties as Tier 2.
